title: Anime List — filter 35,000+ anime and manga
description: Filter and explore 35,000+ anime and manga titles from MyAnimeList with advanced search, statistics, schedules, and watchlists.
markdown: Anime List is an anime and manga discovery app backed by MyAnimeList catalog data. Public discovery works without an account; personal watchlists and schedules require sign-in.

title: Advanced anime search — Anime List
description: Filter anime by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, status, and format with shareable search URLs.
markdown: Use multi-field filters to search the anime catalog by score, year, genre, theme, demographic, popularity, airing status, and format. Search state is shareable in the HTML URL.

title: Random anime picker — Anime List
description: Pick a random anime from the public Anime List catalog and narrow the choice with the same discovery filters used by search.
markdown: The HTML route selects a random anime from the public catalog. Use advanced search when you want to constrain the pick by score, year, genre, or other catalog fields.

title: Anime catalog statistics — Anime List
description: Explore anime score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
markdown: Explore aggregate anime catalog statistics, including distributions by score, year, format, genre, theme, demographic, membership, and favorites.

title: Advanced manga search — Anime List
description: Search and filter more than 20,000 manga titles by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, status, and format.
markdown: Search the public manga catalog with multi-field filters for score, year, genre, theme, demographic, status, format, popularity, and favorites.

title: Manga catalog statistics — Anime List
description: Explore manga score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
markdown: Explore aggregate manga catalog statistics, including distributions by score, year, format, genre, theme, demographic, membership, and favorites.

title: Anime discovery — Anime List
description: Use a signed-in weekly queue or answer four lightweight questions for a private anime taste profile and prefilled search.
markdown: Discovery combines a signed-in weekly queue with a public, privacy-safe taste quiz. Quiz answers are not persisted; analytics retain only the resulting archetype.

title: Anime List changelog
description: Verified product releases for Anime List, including anime and manga discovery, watchlists, schedules, and catalog improvements.
markdown: The HTML changelog owns verified product releases. Catalog ingestion history is maintained separately on the catalog updates page.

title: Anime List catalog updates
description: Review daily anime and manga catalog ingestion history, update timing, and the latest public dataset refreshes.
markdown: The HTML page shows catalog ingestion history from the public API, including the latest anime and manga refresh times and recent changes.

title: About Anime List
description: Learn how Anime List combines MyAnimeList catalog data, advanced filtering, smart ranking, statistics, and personal tracking.
markdown: Anime List helps people discover anime and manga with transparent multi-field filters and ranking, then track personal choices after signing in.

title: Anime List privacy
description: Understand Anime List account data, Google sign-in, watchlist storage, and product analytics.
markdown: Public catalog browsing does not require an account. Google sign-in and an httpOnly authentication cookie are used for personal watchlists, schedules, and access tokens.

title: Anime List terms
description: Terms for using Anime List catalog discovery, personal watchlists, and MyAnimeList-derived metadata.
markdown: Anime List provides discovery and tracking tools without warranty. Catalog scores and metadata come from third-party sources and remain subject to their terms.

title: Anime List MCP setup
description: Connect agents to Anime List public catalog tools and manage a personal access token for authenticated watchlist tools.
markdown: Anime List exposes public MCP catalog tools for search, detail, and statistics. Watchlist tools require a revocable personal access token created after signing in.
